scope: Actual installed Isaac Sim 5.1 public RmpFlow cuboid registration; no arm commands or simulator geometry created.

public_api_findings.registration: RmpFlow.add_cuboid(proxy, static=False) accepts three numeric getters in the installed implementation: get_size, get_local_scale and get_world_pose. The general add_obstacle dispatcher instead checks Isaac wrapper classes.
public_api_findings.no_usd_proxy: A plain Python numeric cuboid is passed to public add_cuboid. No direct private Lula world insertion, USD prim, render product, collider, visual material or semantic object is created.
public_api_findings.world_updates: MotionPolicyController.forward calls RmpFlow.update_world each control step. Dynamic numeric getters return copies in stage units; the SDK converts them to meters and robot-base coordinates. Changed descriptor batches also refresh the world once.
public_api_findings.dimension_updates: The installed update_world refreshes poses, not cuboid dimensions. A resized cuboid is removed and re-added individually; unchanged geometry is not re-registered.
public_api_findings.disable_and_remove: The public disable_obstacle, enable_obstacle and remove_obstacle APIs all succeeded with the same numeric object in the native probe.
public_api_findings.reset: RmpFlow.reset replaces its Lula world/policy and clears registrations. The reactive strategy must call registry.reset_tracking after its backend-owned controller reset, then register the current accepted packet.
public_api_findings.ownership: The registry removes only its owned numeric objects, never resets the controller during cleanup, and asserts its creating thread before every mutation.
public_api_findings.compatibility_limit: Numeric duck typing is verified against this pinned installed 5.1 implementation. Revalidate these public method expectations before an Isaac SDK upgrade.

model_interpretation.covered_approximation: 55 environment-avoidance spheres cover panda_link0 through panda_link7 plus panda_hand: base, shoulder/upper arm, elbow/forearm, wrist and palm/gripper-body approximation.
model_interpretation.finger_limit: The environment sphere list contains no separate finger links. Hand spheres extend only to local z=0.056 m. Finger URDF coordinates are fixed at 0.025 m in the descriptor; actual finger travel is not modeled by updated collision spheres.
model_interpretation.self_collision_distinction: The RMPflow YAML additionally lists fingertip body_collision_controllers against base body_cylinders. Those anchors are not separate environment collision-sphere coverage.
model_interpretation.carried_object_limit: No carried-object geometry is attached to this RMPflow model. Carried-object clearance is not claimed; reactive carrying and intended Pick/Place contact remain explicitly unsupported in this stage.
model_interpretation.unchanged_configuration: No SDK robot descriptor, URDF, RMPflow policy YAML, collision spheres or feedback adapter was modified.
model_interpretation.padding_distinction: Obstacle descriptors have no geometric padding. Existing collision_rmp influence/damping parameters are unchanged and are not extra cuboid dimensions.
